prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1129; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid edge is bent, with the quarter panel showing a crease that matches the reported rear-end impact. The damage pattern lines up well with how the collision was described. Repair labor hours are consistent with the extent of the work, and the parts and labor lines on the estimate show no duplicated charges. Nothing in the inspection or the vehicle's history points to earlier damage in these areas. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, straighten the trunk lid, refinish the quarter panel and recheck alignment of the rear light assembly before final release.
